title: Visual-ERM: Reward Modeling for Visual Equivalence
authors_zh: Ziyu Liu、Shengyuan Ding、Xinyu Fang、Xuanlang Dai、Penghui Yang、Jianze Liang、Jiaqi Wang、Kai Chen、Dahua Lin、Yuhang Zang
paper_type_zh: 视觉等价性奖励模型与基准
best_for_zh: 需要视觉到代码 RL 奖励、视觉差异判定或多模态候选修订反馈的研究者
one_line: Visual-ERM releases VC-RewardBench and a generative reward model that judges fine-grained visual equivalence between target and rendered code outputs.
VC-RewardBench 含 1,335 个图表、表格与 SVG 视觉等价性实例，以位置、类型、严重度反馈支持视觉代码推理奖励。
why: It evaluates rendered visual equivalence directly, exposing error type and severity rather than relying only on text rules or embedding similarity.
inclusion_reason: Visual-ERM offers public fine-grained visual reward supervision and a benchmark for vision-to-code evaluation.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Vision-to-code tasks for charts, tables, and SVGs require judging whether rendered code is visually equivalent to a target image. Textual rules only inspect code structure, while global similarities such as CLIP overlook local position, type, and severity differences and are vulnerable to reward hacking.

Visual-ERM trains a generative reward model that directly compares a target image with a candidate rendering and outputs discrepancy category, location, severity, and explanation. It also releases VC-RewardBench to test visual-equivalence judging with fine-grained discrepancy annotations.

图表、表格和 SVG 的 vision-to-code 任务需要比较生成代码渲染结果与目标图像是否视觉等价，但文本规则只能检查代码结构，CLIP 等全局相似度又会忽略局部位置、类型和严重度差异，容易形成 reward hacking。

Visual-ERM 训练一个直接比较目标图像与候选渲染图的生成式奖励模型，输出错误类别、位置、严重度与解释；同时发布 VC-RewardBench，用细粒度视觉差异标注测试 reward model 的等价性判断。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: Visual-ERM trains a generative reward model that directly compares a target image with a candidate rendering and outputs discrepancy category, location, severity, and explanation. It also releases VC-RewardBench to test visual-equivalence judging with fine-grained discrepancy annotations. The main VC-RewardBench reported in the paper contains 1,335 carefully constructed chart, table, and SVG cases. Each includes a target image, a correct or corrupted candidate rendering, and feedback such as discrepancy type, location, severity, and description. The current Hugging Face viewer may total roughly 2.67K rows across configurations, which should not be equated with 1,335 independent benchmark cases; the licence is Apache-2.0.

Visual-ERM 训练一个直接比较目标图像与候选渲染图的生成式奖励模型，输出错误类别、位置、严重度与解释；同时发布 VC-RewardBench，用细粒度视觉差异标注测试 reward model 的等价性判断。VC-RewardBench 的论文主 benchmark 含 1,335 个精心构造的 chart、table 与 SVG 实例；每条包含目标图像、正确或受扰动的候选渲染，以及错误类型、位置、严重度和描述等反馈。当前 Hugging Face viewer 可能显示多个配置合计约 2.67K 行，不能与 1,335 个独立 benchmark case 直接等同，许可为 Apache-2.0。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Build the source pool: Collect target images and executable code for structured-visual tasks, render references, and separate chart, table, and SVG domains.
  1. Generate or reorganize feedback: Apply controlled perturbations to code or renderings to create local layout, content, style, and structural errors while retaining correct controls.
  1. Verify and filter: Use strong vision models or rules to generate fine-grained target–candidate discrepancy descriptions, then apply automatic checks and human sampling to form training data and VC-RewardBench.
  1. Train and evaluate: Train Visual-ERM to emit structured feedback and use its scores for RL, selection, and revision during test-time reflection.

1. 建立数据源： 收集结构化视觉任务的目标图像与可执行代码，渲染得到视觉参考，并按 chart、table、SVG 分域。
  1. 生成或重组反馈： 对代码或渲染结果施加可控扰动，产生局部布局、内容、样式和结构错误，同时保留正确对照。
  1. 验证与筛选： 将目标—候选图像交给强视觉模型或规则生成细粒度差异描述，再经自动检查与人工抽样形成 VC-RewardBench 和训练数据。
  1. 训练与评测： 训练 Visual-ERM 输出结构化反馈，并在 RL 或 test-time reflection 中把评分用于更新、筛选和修订生成代码。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Using Visual-ERM for RL with Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct improves chart-to-code by 8.4 points and table and SVG parsing by 2.7 and 4.1 points on average. On VC-RewardBench, the 8B Visual-ERM substantially outperforms Qwen3-VL-235B-Instruct and approaches leading closed models. The evidence supports fine-grained visual feedback but covers only three structured-image families. These results support the central claim only under the released data, model scales, candidate budgets, and evaluation protocols; cross-domain use requires new validation.

把 Visual-ERM 用于 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 的 RL 后，chart-to-code 提高 8.4 点，table 和 SVG 分别平均提高 2.7 与 4.1 点；在 VC-RewardBench 上，8B Visual-ERM 明显超过 Qwen3-VL-235B-Instruct，并接近领先闭源模型。该证据支持细粒度视觉反馈，但只覆盖三类结构化图像。 这些结果支持论文的核心主张，但只适用于其公开数据、模型规模、候选预算和评测协议；跨领域使用仍需重新验证。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior vision-to-code rewards rely mainly on code rules or a single global image-similarity score. Visual-ERM changes the reward object to interpretable local discrepancies between two renderings and uses the same feedback for policy training and test-time reflection and revision.
已有 vision-to-code reward 主要依赖代码规则或一个全局图像相似度；Visual-ERM 将 reward object 改为两幅渲染图之间的可解释局部差异，并让同一反馈既可训练 policy，也可驱动推理时反思与修订。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Coverage boundary: Visual equivalence does not ensure maintainable, accessible, or semantically correct code; executable and task-specific checks remain necessary.
  1. Feedback risk: Synthetic perturbations may be more regular than real model failures, causing the RM to overfit predefined error categories.
  1. Reproduction and use: The 1,335 benchmark cases and multi-configuration row counts use different units; reproduction must freeze configurations and deduplication rules.

1. 覆盖边界： 视觉等价不保证代码可维护、可访问或语义正确，必须同时运行代码与任务特定检查器。
  1. 反馈风险： 合成扰动可能比真实模型错误更规则，reward model 在自然失败模式上可能过拟合错误类别。
  1. 复现与使用： benchmark 的 1,335 case 与数据页多配置行数口径不同，复现实验必须固定配置和去重规则。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Evaluation: Evaluate visual RMs that compare target and candidate renderings.
  1. Training: Provide dense feedback for chart, table, and SVG generation, combined with executable-correctness rewards during RL.
  1. Transfer or deployment: Use structured discrepancies as automatic critiques for code revision and assess success with both visual metrics and functional tests.

1. 评测： 评测能够比较 target rendering 与 candidate rendering 的视觉 reward model。
  1. 训练： 为 chart/table/SVG 生成提供密集反馈，联合可执行正确性奖励进行 RL。
  1. 迁移或部署： 把结构化 discrepancy 用作自动 critique，驱动候选代码修订；成功标准需包含视觉指标与功能测试。
